.

is
not
true
.

main
reason
for
hiring
younger
workers
is
payroll
.

most
countries
,
your
salary
is
dependent
on
how
many
years
of
work
experience
you
have
.
It
is
far
more
cost

to
hire
postgraduates
,

,
